title: add ipv6-dualstack registry-mirror terraform module and offline ingress/metallb bundles
author: Priya Nair
description: Motivation: Customers running in strict on-prem and VPC environments with IPv6-only or dual-stack networks reported manual work to wire up registry mirrors and load-balancers for air-gapped installs. This PR adds a reusable Terraform module to provision a registry-mirror (with optional S3-backed blob proxy), updates the offline bundle index with an IPv6-capable ingress-nginx + metallb manifests, and wires preflight/upgrade hooks to validate dual-stack compatibility and checksum versions. Summary of changes: 1) terraform/modules/registry-mirror: new module to create an internal registry mirror and a small nginx proxy that can be used to serve OCI image indexes for airgap installs. Supports optional s3 backend, TLS termination via provided cert secrets, and a minimal healthcheck. 2) installer/airgap/bundles: added ingress-nginx and metallb IPv6-dualstack variants (manifests and Helm values) and a smaller manifest index optimized for limited storage nodes. 3) scripts/preflight: ipv6 detection and checksum verifier (checks bundle sha256, registry index integrity, and kernel module requirements for certain kube distros). 4) terraform/examples/airgap-aws: example wiring showing private VPC endpoints + mirror + route53 internal AAAA records. 5) docs/airgap-ipv6.md: operational notes and upgrade/rollback procedure for clusters converting from IPv4-only to dual-stack. Compatibility notes and migration: The registry-mirror module is designed to be additive; existing installs can opt in without changing runtime images. The IPv6 manifests are provided as separate Helm value overlays so customers can test before flipping defaults. Upgrade hooks: the installer will now run the checksum verifier and a dry-run apply of the Helm manifests; on failure the upgrade will be aborted and a rollback manifest is recorded in installer/upgrades/rollbacks/<ts>-metadata.json (metadata only, manifests stored in local tarball). Testing: manual verification against k3s (v1.26) and rke2 (v1.26) in dual-stack lab, and ephemeral smoke tests in CI (unit/terraform fmt/checks). Backwards compatibility: No breaking changes to existing airgap flows; new resources behind feature flags. Linear/related: ENG-1248 (airgap ipv6 initiative), INF-982 (registry mirror module). Release note: Adds optional IPv6 dual-stack offline bundles and a Terraform module for creating a private registry mirror to support air-gapped installs.

María González (reviewer): ingress-nginx dualstack manifests look fine; please ensure metallb config has explicit address-pools for AAAA ranges and document expectations for layer2 vs bgp setups.
Priya Nair (author): Updated metallb manifest with example IPv6 address-pools and added operational notes in docs/airgap-ipv6.md. Also included a short checklist for customers converting clusters.
